summary: Legacy subject/room/card typed IDs, schema IDs, and cx.subject.* / cx.room.* / cx.card.* event contracts are removed from the active v1 wire contract.
producer_requirements: Producers MUST emit cx:flow:<ulid> for all legacy room/card/subject-derived collaboration objects.
Producers MUST emit cx.schema.flow.v1 instead of cx.schema.subject.v1, cx.schema.room.v1, or cx.schema.card.v1.
Producers MUST emit cx.flow.* event kinds for direct flow lifecycle and patch operations.
Producers MUST NOT emit removed legacy event kinds, schema IDs, or typed ID prefixes on the active wire.
consumer_requirements: Consumers MAY migrate historical local storage from legacy IDs into flow IDs before replay or re-export.
Consumers MUST treat removed legacy event kinds and schema IDs as unsupported on the active v1 wire contract.
Validators and CI SHOULD reject reintroduction of removed legacy typed IDs, schema IDs, and event kinds.

id_kind_mappings.migration_semantics: Subject-centric collaboration identity is absorbed into the unified Flow object model.
Discussion-capable room objects are represented as Flow objects with kind=room.
Board/list task cards are represented as Flow objects with kind=card.

removed_without_direct_alias.replacement_semantics: Represent the primary discussion surface through Flow discussion-branch state and projection semantics instead of a standalone subject-surface link event.
Disable or deproject the relevant Flow discussion surface via branch state instead of a standalone subject-surface unlink event.
Use Flow branch primary-state semantics instead of a dedicated subject-surface primary event.
Use Flow discussion-branch enablement and projection semantics instead of a card-room link event.
Use Flow discussion-branch disablement or projection semantics instead of a card-room unlink event.
Use Flow branch primary-state semantics instead of a card-room primary-link event.
